cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

mechanism: A asserts final authority over the available complaint route, adapting practical details so B drops the special demand and participates in the official process.
confusable: Simply silencing a complaint is confusable: A must get B onto the actual process, using B obstacle or solution rather than refusing all help.
comparison: Parcel case lets A become evidence instead of a demanded driver witness; fete queue gives public recognition while preserving equal waiting.
seedUse: Read exact cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve the helpful accommodations; real authority should decide which alternative counts while A participates sincerely.
